title: Brick Legends
description: Lead your own avatar, a mage and a healer across a blocky kingdom in a classic turn-based quest: explore towns, take on side quests, exploit fire, ice and thunder weaknesses and recover three crystals to defeat the Hollow King.
controls: Arrows / WASD move and choose, Enter / Space / Z confirm and talk, X / Backspace cancel, Q menu, M map, N music (mouse works in menus)
